decisions.reason: As a recent, publicly presented extension of the core cardboard display range, it fits the firm's stated innovation path and management would be inclined to continue backing it rather than reverse course after initial investment.
Because it is close to the established offer, was given visible market exposure on its own page, and supports the firm's one-stop display proposition, management would likely persist with it.
This quarter-pallet display sits squarely in the firm's core business, so with resources already committed and no clear evidence of failure, escalation of commitment points to retaining it.
Its strong fit with the existing shelf-display portfolio and the firm's public launch make management likely to treat any early weakness as temporary and keep it on the market.

Although slightly broader than the core cardboard line, the wooden display pallet still builds on the firm's display capabilities and visible commitment, which makes continued support the more likely choice.
As a close-to-core quarter-pallet variant that broadens application to media products, it reinforces the announced strategy of quality and innovation, encouraging management to continue with it.
